title: onda sessions.json
description: State of the agent sessions as seen by Onda, written to $AB_HOME/onda/sessions.json (default ~/.agent-team-os/onda/sessions.json). Written atomically (tmp + rename), on every state change, at most once per second. Onda never creates the bus folder. Readers MUST tolerate a missing, stale (dead ondaPid) or unparsable file and an unknown 'v'. Requests in the opposite direction are files in $AB_HOME/onda/requests/ (see $defs/request).

v.description: Schema major version. A reader receiving an unknown v discards the file.

ondaPid.description: Pid of the writing Onda process. If it is not alive the file is a leftover.

state.description: pending_input = prompt box has text and no work signal for >= 60 s; before 60 s it stays idle. A reader treats an unknown state as idle.

agent.description: Agent from AGENT_MAP; null when the folder is not mapped.

stateSince.description: Start of the current state. For pending_input, the start of the episode, not the moment the 60 s elapsed.

lastTarget.description: Target of the last tool, relative to cwd. Never file contents.

mounted.description: The workspace is in the mosaic of an open window.

hasText.description: Optional (bus v2.6). The prompt box holds text right now, even typed less than 60 s ago (stricter than pending_input). null when the screen is not read (pane not mounted, stale report). Its presence also tells a reader that agent.prompt accepts onlyIfIdle: the wake script refuses to inject into an Onda without it.

windowId.description: Hosting window; null when mounted is false.

host.description: Machine the session runs on. Today always 'laptop'.

request.title: onda request
request.description: File $AB_HOME/onda/requests/req-<ts>-<rand>.json, written by the mod (atomically; temp files must not start with 'req-'), consumed and deleted by Onda. Unknown actions are discarded and deleted.

action.description: Mount the workspace in the active (or first) window and focus the agent's pane.
